intro: Fifteen articles on backdoors, published between 2026-04-13 and 2026-09-24, examine activity tied to Silver Fox, APT41, and CL-STA-1062. Coverage spans government, technology, financial services, software development, and banking, with incidents reported globally and in India, Russia, South asia, and South korea. The severity mix comprises 12 high and 2 critical items. The archive tracks how backdoor access is pursued across these sectors and regions, and how the three named actors feature in reporting over the five-month period.
